units.source_text: 源氏内大臣时刻挂念嵯峨山中大堰邸内那个人。

en.t: Minister Genji was constantly thinking of that person at the Oi residence deep in the Saga hills.

units.source_text: 但因身份高贵，不便轻易去访。

en.t: But because of his exalted rank, it was not convenient for him to visit casually.

units.source_text: 他想：“明石姬为了自己出身低微，所以嫌恶人世，避免交游，其实何必如此自卑呢？

en.t: He thought, "Because Lady Akashi feels her own birth is low, she shuns the world and avoids society; but why must she humble herself so much?

units.source_text: 但她不肯轻易迁居东院，低头与众人共处，则又未免太高傲了。”

en.t: Yet her refusal to move readily to the eastern mansion and lower herself to live among the others is, after all, rather too proud."

units.source_text: 推察她的心情，实甚可怜。

en.t: When he considered her feelings, he found her truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 于是照例借口嵯峨佛堂必须不断念佛，赴大堰邸访问了。

en.t: So, as usual, he used the excuse that prayers at the Saga chapel must not be allowed to cease, and went to visit the Oi residence.
